sold.remarks: *Multiple offers, please submit your best by 5pm 6/29*A fantastic opportunity to own a beautifully updated JUMBO 2-unit building in Auburn Gresham! Renovated in 2018 with the first-floor unit recently refreshed, this property is ideal for both owner-occupants and savvy investors. The vacant first-floor unit is move-in ready, offering the flexibility to live in one unit while generating rental income from the other, or to place your own tenant at current market rates.  Each oversized unit features 3 spacious bedrooms, 1 full bath, in-unit laundry, and generous room sizes designed for comfortable living. The bedrooms easily accommodate king-size furniture and include walk-in closets. The kitchens and bathrooms are finished with granite countertops, and Unit 1 boasts stainless steel appliances along with a large walk-in pantry. Climate Guard windows and forced-air heating provide year-round comfort-no radiator heat here!  Major improvements include a new roof and tuckpointing completed in 2020. Additional highlights include separate furnaces and water heaters for each unit, an enclosed rear porch, and an expansive unfinished basement offering outstanding potential for future living space, storage, or additional income opportunities. Whether you're looking to expand your investment portfolio or purchase your first multi-unit property, this one checks all the boxes.

sold.remarks: This brick 2 flat that has been well-maintained and loved by a long term owner features a full unfinished basement, backyard, and 2-car garage in a convenient location adjacent to a playground. Each unit features central air, updated windows, large bedrooms, formal dining room and newer furnaces. Unit 2 is occupied by a stable tenant, while Unit 1 is vacant and move-in ready with new appliances including a dishwasher for an owner-occupant or new tenant. Major improvements include updated electrical and plumbing, plus a tear-off roof completed approximately 5 years ago and was recently sealed for added longevity. Each unit also offers a spacious primary bedroom with a large adjacent room that can serve as a third bedroom, office, or dream walk-in closet. Great opportunity for investors or buyers looking to live in one unit and collect rental income from the other. Nothing to do but move in and enjoy owning a well-maintained piece of Chicago.

sold.remarks: Recently renovated duplexed-down all-brick 2-unit building offering 6 bedrooms and 2.1 bathrooms in the vibrant Auburn Gresham neighborhood. Situated on a well-maintained block just minutes from downtown Chicago, this turnkey investment presents an excellent opportunity for both owner-occupants and investors. The main-level unit features a spacious eat-in kitchen with ample cabinets, granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, custom tile backsplash, and hardwood flooring. The spacious living room showcases original built-ins with custom glasswork and a decorative fireplace, blending timeless character with modern updates. Two bedrooms and a tastefully renovated full bath complete the main level, while the finished lower level offers a large family room, two additional bedrooms, an updated powder room, laundry area, and ample storage. The upper unit has also been thoughtfully remodeled with an eat-in kitchen featuring new cabinetry, updated countertops, stainless steel appliances, a breakfast peninsula, and new LVP flooring. Featuring another generous living room with original built-ins and a decorative fireplace, two bedrooms and a renovated full bathroom. 2 car garage for convenience and added storage. All improvements were completed with approved plans and permits including new HVAC systems, electrical, plumbing, appliances, vanities, flooring, lighting, paint, and a new rear staircase. Each unit is equipped with separate forced-air heating and central air conditioning, providing added efficiency and individual tenant control. Conveniently located near parks, schools, shopping, dining, and public transportation, this move-in-ready property is well-positioned to attract strong, long-term tenant demand.

Nearly every major component has been updated, giving buyers peace of mind for years to come. The property boasts a brand-new roof along with extensive interior renovations, providing a clean, modern feel throughout. Whether you're looking to help your mortgage by living in one unit while renting the other or seeking a low-maintenance income-producing property, this building is well suited for a variety of buyers.    Located on a desirable, well-kept block, this solid brick building offers excellent curb appeal and long-term durability. The spacious units provide comfortable living for tenants or homeowners alike, making this an ideal addition to any investment portfolio. With strong rental potential, modern updates, and a move-in-ready condition, this is an opportunity you won't want to miss.    Schedule your private showing today and see everything this beautifully updated two-flat has to offer.

method: Closed sales of 2 to 4 unit income properties with 4 to 8 bedrooms in ZIPs 60620 and 60621, November 2025 to November 2026: 186 sales reviewed, almost all of them 2-flats.

Condition drives price on this stretch: fresh rehabs within half a mile sold for about $375,000 to $475,000, while as-is buildings sold for $150,000 to $275,000. The subject was rehabbed in 2025 but now shows wear, so the value comps are well-kept and older-rehab 2-flats, with fresh rehabs as the upper bound and ceiling and an as-is sale as the floor.
History: the subject was listed in 2025 at $399,000, then $390,000, then $377,777, freshly rehabbed and fully leased, and was cancelled after 194 cumulative days without a sale.

Existing rent-to-price ratio uses the monthly rents reported in the MLS divided by the sold price (or list price for active listings). Vacant or unreported units are excluded, so a partial figure understates the building's potential.

Market change since sale: each sold comp is adjusted to today using MRED InfoSparks median sale price of 2 to 4 unit buildings in Auburn Gresham, down 5.1% since October 2025 (figure provided by Kevin Waters from InfoSparks, November 9, 2026), prorated by months since the sale. The value range comes from the anchor and supporting comps at their adjusted prices.
Condition assessed from listing remarks and the listing agent's description of the subject; no interior inspection of any comparable.
Data from the MRED MLS via Repliers, pulled November 9, 2026.
